whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.paragraph1: Beka Solutions Boston Consulting Hub was established in 2019 and provides financial consulting, accounting, notary and insurance services to businesses in Boston and surrounding areas.
whoWeAre.paragraph2: With our approach that blends Turkish and American business cultures, we offer solutions to our customers from both local and international perspectives.
whoWeAre.paragraph3: Thanks to our expert staff, we develop customized solutions for your business needs and create strategies for sustainable growth.
